The '''swimming grain maggot''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] found in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The maggots were edible, and could be served at a [[Granee Noopa]].<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
